script_text: Scorpio, your ruling planet Pluto is waking up something powerful in your chart this week, so buckle up. Early week, Mercury in your 10th House squares Mars in your 7th, creating tension in partnerships — Tuesday is the worst day because arguments with a business partner or lover could escalate fast. But Wednesday is your turning point as Venus sextiles your natal Sun, flooding your 5th House of romance with magnetic energy — someone unexpected reaches out. By Thursday, Jupiter trines your 2nd House of money, bringing a financial breakthrough or unexpected income through the weekend. Saturday glows with confidence as the Sun enters your 11th House, perfect for networking and social connections. Your best day is Wednesday because Venus sextiles your Sun, igniting love and creativity. Your worst day is Tuesday due to the Mercury-Mars square sparking conflict. This week, Scorpio, let your water-element intuition guide every decision — don't force outcomes. Follow for daily updates.
